Source of truth: `kit.py` and `evaluate.py`, read before design. Policies observe only the JSON state and their serialized memory. Observable quantities are member attributes and answered fields, field statuses, availability, assignment day and dyad identities, received events, clarification log, current day and budget. An evaluated policy cannot read the episode's family, latent truth or seed from the JSON interface; a fixed prior or posterior mixture is an assumption, not an observation.

A smaller model can beat a better-specified probability model through querying or stochastic finite-seed effects; no toy result establishes a production winner.
